source_anchors.evidence: inject_stylesheet and remove_stylesheet require css:string with min length 1; optional integer tab_id; use assigned tab when omitted; call chrome.scripting.insertCSS/removeCSS and return {ok:true} or {ok:false,reason}. Both tier privileged. The leaf Zod objects are non-strict, so unrecognized keys are stripped rather than rejected.

stylesheet accepts action enum inject|remove, css:string min length 1, optional integer tab_id; delegates to the corresponding leaf handler. No persistent argument exists in live source schema. The Zod object is non-strict, so unrecognized keys are stripped rather than rejected.

Tools tab parses JSON and validates local handler schema, then calls handler.run directly with permissionMode act. Its Run control skips the dispatcher permission gate; UI labels this Test mode bypasses approval. Inline result is handler output, not proof of page appearance.

Normal delegated execution validates schema, enforces Pilot tab-group scope, then requests confirmation for privileged tools regardless of Ask/Act mode. These inventory entry points defer delegated agent calls to Chat/Pilot; no such path is exercised by the manual Tools runner.
inject_stylesheet and remove_stylesheet declare activeTab and scripting as required permissions.

cases.name: inject_stylesheet
cases.title: Controlled manual execution: inject_stylesheet
steps: Meet procedure_prerequisites for the selected role; record the current resource permit and receipt. Open the owned /referrals fixture route from tests/browser/scrape-guest-native-acceptance.mjs (use the current ephemeral URL and tab ID from its receipt, not a guessed port) in a newly owned tab and record its exact tab ID.

Observe and record the h1 baseline color and background. In Tools, locate inject_stylesheet, enter exactly {"css":"h1 { color: rgb(190, 24, 93) !important; background-color: rgb(255, 237, 213) !important; }","tab_id":<owned-tab-id>} and click Run. The integer placeholder must be replaced by the receipt's actual owned tab ID.
Record inline handler output and separately observe the owned fixture h1. Require the proposed pink text and peach background to be visible before assigning a visual pass.

On the same owned tab, run remove_stylesheet with the exact CSS and tab_id above; confirm the h1 returns to its captured baseline. This is cleanup only; the separate remove case owns that control verdict.

Run invalid-input checks separately in the same manual runner: empty css, numeric css, string tab_id. Record each schema rejection and verify the fixture appearance did not change. Do not include unknown keys: Zod strips them and the handler may execute.

Reload the owned page and record baseline restoration. If a fresh-build/reload case is required, perform the PLAN.md reload sequence with a new receipt and repeat on this owned tab; do not assert CSS survives document reload.
expected_observations: Valid manual call returns {ok:true}; this alone remains insufficient for visual acceptance.
After valid injection, the owned visible h1 has rgb(190, 24, 93) text and rgb(255, 237, 213) background; after exact same-run removal and page reload, it returns to captured baseline styling.
Invalid values fail schema validation before handler execution and produce no visible style change.
